details:
**Q1: Which exact rule should mark integration sync as `superseded-by-main`?**
Choices:
- **A** — Mark superseded when branch trees are identical (`integration^{tree} == default^{tree}`), even if histories diverge/conflict (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Mark superseded when compare API reports no net file differences between branches (even if trees/commits differ)
- **C** — Mark superseded only when integration is an ancestor of default (fast-forward equivalent)
Reply: `Q1: A`
**Q2: When superseded state is already set, how should it be cleared?**
Choices:
- **A** — Re-evaluate each poll; clear automatically once equivalence no longer holds, then resume normal sync attempts (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Keep sticky for the project lifetime (never auto-clear)
- **C** — Keep sticky until a manual reset command/comment is posted
Reply: `Q2: A`
